heading: Obsolete references
lead: In any case in which— such statutory provision or authority shall be deemed to refer, in lieu of such basic rate, to the per annum gross rate which an employee receiving such basic rate immediately prior to the effective date of this section would receive, without regard to such statutory provision or authority, under section 1842 of this title on and after such date.

tree.text: the rate of pay of, or any maximum or minimum rate of pay with respect to— is referred to in or provided by statute or other authority; and

children.text: any employee described in subparagraph (1) or subparagraph (2) of section 1841 of this title, or
the position of such employee, or
any class or group of such employees or positions,

tree.text: the rate so referred to or provided is a basic rate with respect to which additional pay is provided by law;

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The effective date of this section, referred to in text, means immediately prior to noon on Jan. 3, 1971. See section 601(1) of Pub. L. 91–510, set out as an Effective Date of 1970 Amendment note under section 4301 of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was classified to section 166b–1c of former Title 40, prior to the enactment of Title 40, Public Buildings, Property, and Works, by Pub. L. 107–217, § 1, Aug. 21, 2002, 116 Stat. 1062.
